Metadata.CommitMsg:
[PHASE-7] Enterprise UI redesigns + NovaRetail TLS via Caddy sidecar

- NovaRetail: enterprise ops console (KPIs, stock pills, order modal, toasts,
  auto-refresh) — verified in browser incl. order flow
- BluePeak: matching enterprise portal (health cards, status pills, drag-drop
  uploads, toasts) — verified locally incl. upload flow
- compute-vm module: optional tls_domain -> Caddy sidecar with automatic
  Let's Encrypt HTTPS; app internal-only; firewall 80/443
- Deployed to VM; cert issuance pending DuckDNS A record (NXDOMAIN retries)
Metadata.Author: CloudBridge <cloudbridge@portfolio.local>

Misconfigurations.Title: Disable project-wide SSH keys for all instances
Misconfigurations.Description: Use of project-wide SSH keys means that a compromise of any one of these key pairs can result in all instances being compromised. It is recommended to use instance-level keys.
Misconfigurations.Message: Instance allows use of project-level SSH keys.

Lines.Content: # Container-Optimized OS: configure the AR credential helper, then run
Lines.Highlighted: # Container-Optimized OS: configure the AR credential helper, then run

Lines.Content: # the app with a restart policy. /var/lib is stateful across reboots.
Lines.Highlighted: # the app with a restart policy. /var/lib is stateful across reboots.

RenderedCause.Raw:
resource "google_compute_instance" "this" {
  metadata = {
    startup-script = "#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
# Container-Optimized OS: configure the AR credential helper, then run
# the app with a restart policy. /var/lib is stateful across reboots.
docker-credential-gcr configure-docker --registries=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev || true
mkdir -p /var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail
docker rm -f cloudbridge-novaretail >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d --name cloudbridge-novaretail --restart always \
  -p 80:8000 \
  -e NOVA_DB_PATH=/app/data/nova.db \
  -v /var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail:/app/data \
  us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/iconic-being-431804-c2/cloudbridge-us/novaretail:latest
"
  }
}

Misconfigurations.Title: VM disks should be encrypted with Customer Supplied Encryption Keys
Misconfigurations.Description: Using unmanaged keys makes rotation and general management difficult.

Misconfigurations.Title: Instances should not override the project setting for OS Login
Misconfigurations.Description: OS Login automatically revokes the relevant SSH keys when an IAM user has their access revoked.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable OS Login at project level and remove instance-level overrides

Misconfigurations.Title: Disable Default Firewall Rules
Misconfigurations.Description:
Ensures that Google Cloud's default firewall rules are disabled, as they may be overly permissive and pose security risks.
The default network comes with pre-populated firewall rules that allow broad access and should be replaced with more restrictive custom rules.
Misconfigurations.Message: Default firewall rule should be disabled and replaced with more restrictive rules.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Replace default firewall rules with custom, more restrictive rules appropriate for your security requirements

Lines.Highlighted: [38;5;239m    # Checkov CKV_GCP_32: block project-wide SSH keys (instance-level keys via

RenderedCause.Raw:
resource "google_compute_instance" "this" {
  metadata = {
    block-project-ssh-keys = "TRUE"
    startup-script         = "#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
# Container-Optimized OS: root FS is read-only — put the docker credential
# config on the writable stateful partition or AR auth fails.
export DOCKER_CONFIG=/var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail/docker-config
mkdir -p "$DOCKER_CONFIG" /var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail
# The container runs as a non-root user; the bind-mounted data dir must
# be writable by it (host dirs are root-owned by default).
chmod 0777 /var/lib/cloudbridge-novaretail
# COS guest firewall defaults to INPUT DROP (only SSH/lo/icmp). Open the
# app ports in the guest chain too — the VPC firewall alone is not enough.
iptables -C INPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || \
  iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT

iptables -C INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || \
  iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT

docker-credential-gcr configure-docker --registries=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev
docker network create cloudbridge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker rm -f cloudbridge-novaretail caddy >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
"
  }
}
